tests.title: Visitor filters organization repositories for public repo and opens it; private repo remains hidden and direct access denied
checks: Repositories tab shows only public repository name, description, visibility, and update time for public repo `acme-docs`
Private repository name is never displayed in the list or when entered exactly in filter
Clicking public repository result opens heading `Acme Demo/acme-docs`
After refresh or Back, filtered results still hide unauthorized private repository
Directly opening the private repository URL without authorization requires sign-in or shows access denied

tests.title: Signed-in user browses organization repositories and sees only repositories with read permission; visibility persists after reload
checks: After signing in as `alice-dev`, Repositories tab lists only repositories the current user is authorized to view
Exact private repository name search does not expose its link to the signed-in user without permission
Visible repository rows display name, description, visibility, and update time with no write operations
Refreshing or reopening the organization page preserves the visible repository set and hides unauthorized repositories

tests.title: Signed-in user creates unique organization `mobile-guild`; becomes Owner and member, and organization persists
checks: Entering organization identifier `mobile-guild` and display name `Mobile Guild` then clicking `Create organization` redirects to new organization overview
New overview heading contains organization identifier `mobile-guild`
Current user is shown as Owner and organization member
Organization appears in `Your organizations` list in the account menu
After refreshing overview and reopening organization list, the organization still exists

tests.title: Duplicate organization identifier is rejected with `Organization name already exists` even when display name is missing
checks: Submitting an existing organization identifier displays `Organization name already exists` beside the field
The error appears even when display name is left missing
Page remains on creation form and does not navigate to the existing organization heading
No new organization object is created and the existing organization is unchanged

tests.title: Malformed organization name `-invalid-organization` and whitespace-only display name are rejected with field errors
checks: Entering `-invalid-organization` displays `Organization name format is invalid`
Entering a whitespace-only display name displays `Display name is required`
Non-sensitive input is retained in the form
No organization is created and no organization list entry appears after reload

tests.title: Organization Owner creates team `mobile-team` with optional parent; team page and tree persist after reload
checks: Owner clicks `New team`, enters team name `mobile-team` and optional description/parent, then `Create team`
Redirects to team page with heading `Acme Demo/mobile-team`
Team tree shows owning organization and selected parent team
Team appears on the organization Teams list
After refreshing team page and Teams list, team and parent-child relationship remain consistent

tests.title: Non-owner cannot access `New team` or create a team; no team record is created
checks: Signed-in non-owner opening Teams tab does not see an actionable `New team` link or activation is rejected
Attempted team creation is rejected and displays no team name error
After reload, no new team exists in the organization team list

tests.title: Maintainer adds and removes organization member `bob-reviewer` and saves parent team; relationships persist after reload
checks: Using `Add member` on Members page adds `bob-reviewer`; complete username appears exactly once in member list
After `Remove bob-reviewer` is activated, username disappears immediately and after reload
Selecting a non-cyclic candidate parent team in Settings and saving updates the team tree
After refreshing member page and organization team tree, only saved parent and membership relationships display
Non-organization members cannot be added

tests.title: Cyclic team hierarchy selection is rejected; original parent remains and persists after reload
checks: Selecting a descendant team as new parent and saving displays `Cyclic team hierarchy is not allowed`
The team's original parent remains selected
After reload, original hierarchy continues to display and no cycle is saved

tests.title: Owner adds a registered non-member as Member; target sees organization but no private repo access; membership persists
checks: Owner enters target username/verified email, selects `Member`, and clicks `Add member`
People page immediately displays full target username with Member role and no Pending state
Target account on next sign-in sees organization in `Your organizations` and organization overview
Target account does not gain access to an ungranted private repository and sees `Access denied`
After Owner refresh and target refresh, both read same membership relationship; duplicate membership is not created

tests.title: Adding unknown account `unknown-reviewer` displays `Account not found` and no membership is created
checks: Submitting unknown username `unknown-reviewer` displays `Account not found` beside the corresponding field
The Add member form remains open so username can be corrected and resubmitted
No membership row is added to People page
After reload, People list unchanged and unknown account has no organization relationship

tests.title: Owner removes a member; org membership and org-scoped access revoked while personal account and repositories remain
checks: Owner clicks `Member menu <username>` → `Remove from organization` → `Remove`
Member username is absent from People page immediately and after reload
Account loses access to private organization resources obtained solely through organization membership
Removed account can still sign in and access its personal account and personal repository
Teams themselves and team grants are not deleted; last Owner cannot be removed

tests.title: Non-owner has no remove controls or removal is rejected; member remains in organization after reload
checks: Non-owner viewing People page sees no `Member menu` button or `Remove from organization` menuitem for any member
Attempted removal operation is unavailable or rejected by server
After reload, the member still belongs to the organization
No membership, team membership, or direct grant relationships are deleted

tests.title: Repo Admin grants Write access to an organization team; single grant persists and authorized team member gains private repo access
checks: In Manage access, administrator selects team option from search picker, chooses `Write`, and confirms Add/Save
Authorization list displays exactly one row for the team with Write role
Saving the same role again for the same subject does not create a second authorization record
A member of the granted team can open the private repository and perform Write operations
Unauthorized accounts cannot see the private repository; grant persists after refresh

tests.title: Changing an existing team grant from Write to Read replaces the original role; one team row remains after reload
checks: Existing grant row shows team name and Write role with a native Role select and Save button
Changing role to `Read` and saving replaces Write with Read
Only one authorization record for the team remains after save
After refreshing Manage access page, the updated Read grant is still displayed
Old Write permission is no longer effective for the team
